coverage_semantics: audit/replayPASS is evidence of reproduction only. complete_task and original_qualified are separate booleans; complete motion-fail stays unqualified.

Ordinary full record requires exact original reproduction, finite JF/JM, native dose/native motion, motion acceptance boolean and qualification boolean. Qualified true additionally requires original mode/physical/scientific PASS and motion acceptance.

Ordinary partial requires explicit qualifiedfalse/originalFAIL and null full JF/JM/native dose/native motion/motion replay; native increment comes only from exact physical snapshot. Hard11 detail UNKNOWN if not retained; no full motion or cost rank.

Original26 is reused by exact SHA/pointer and snapshot increment agreement. Boundary requires observed/native counter evidence, TASK evaluation N/A. Original partial hard11 preserved in existing receipt, no full task qualification inferred.

C4 full rows retain original evaluator+native/motion+5ms integrals; C4 partials require original evaluator FAIL/original worker qualifiedfalse/hard11 fields/fullarraysNone/fullqualificationnotimputed.
Boundary distinct: native/session only, complete_task/original_qualified=None and TASK scorer N/A; count once in physical universe.
Overlapping receipts per id are explicit supporting evidence, physical_count_contribution=1; any scope/qualification disagreement is a gap, never majority vote.
No matching actual receipt or missing relevant native/evaluator evidence => explicit gap or exception failure. New name/old auditPASS is never substitute evidence.
All opened metadata SHA rechecked before output, including ATTEMPTS, no CURRENT pointer/time-latest selection.
No independent patient count, global GPU/CPU total, selector savings, or future outcomes inferred.
deadline: min(entry+approved<=60s, authority expires, original global stop); fixed monotonic deadline checked on metadata reads/loop/end; never reset
execution_constraints: mainvenv/-B/PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE1/threads1; external timeout --kill-after=2s 60s; CPU affinity1 and RLIMIT_AS1GiB inside helper; no execution or --help/probe authorized now
failure_policy: retain paid work and all failure/gap evidence; no automatic retry or silent scope narrowing

inputs.ATTEMPTS: only allowed runtime file runtime/ATTEMPTS.jsonl; whole bytes SHA pinned; START/END hashes are raw line WITHOUT newline as original snapshot, exact current IDs must equal snapshot IDs
inputs.C4: main-pinned CONVAL01/02 RESULT+END only after closed; matching counts.group/status/errors/END resultSHA; actual trials and boundaries only, NOT_RUN roles and aliases not physical IDs
inputs.closure: each snapshot group owned/<group>_SUPERVISOR_END.json SHA must equal snapshot supervisor.evidence_sha256; STOP/survivors[]/known exit required, failure exit permitted as closed evidence
inputs.main_approval: new exact status+source manifest SHA+contract SHA+physical snapshot path/SHA+all inputs path/SHA+unique output+expires<=original stop; main verifies all physical owners closed
inputs.ordinary: approval.scorer_replay_files_sha256 exact allowlist; existing audit/scorer_replay/<id>.json only; includes future DevCap/POSTAPP only when actual receipt exists with supported fields

original26.entry_binding: receipt actual path+SHA, JSON pointer, compact sorted canonical stored-row SHA, actual id, START/END line SHA, evaluator pointer; three underlying old audit JSON files also separately main-pinned

inputs.raw_identity: existing raw input SHA strings carried as declared provenance only; trace/native/DATA/PARTIAL inputs are never opened or rehashed

output: unique family audit/coverage_runs/<newrun>/RESULT.json + END.json; explicit gaps exit2; post-auth exception FAILURE.json and nonzero; pre-auth/pre-output rejection has external launcher log only
purpose: 按exact CLOSED_EXACT全physical START/END全集聚合已有原重算证据；不重算原26，不制造新评价或新物理。
